placements.title: Meridian deploys gated by signed release manifests
placements.theme: Every Meridian deployment requires a signed release manifest before it ships, justified by prior unsigned artifacts and scoped to staging and production under named ownership.
placements.why: src-1 institutes the signed-manifest requirement; src-2 is the grounds (unsigned artifacts last quarter)—evidence for the gate, not a separate subject; src-3–src-5 settle gate, scope, and owner as the decision package. Together they name one standing thematic subject future envelopes can keep feeding: Meridian's signed-manifest deployment gate. Graph and strata were empty, so this is a foundational mint with no under.
